zh: 情境图表：论当代艺术中语境与形式的解／重组之呈现
en: The situational diagram: on rendering the de/recomposition of context and form in contemporary art

en: JALEH MANSOOR

zh: 线条无法逃脱它进入世界时的现在时态，正如它无法逃入油画那抹除与隐藏的秘密藏身之处。因此，这一根本状况能使它比图像更接近观者自身的处境。
en: Line can no more escape the present tense of its entry into the world than it can escape into oil paint’s secret hiding place of erasure and concealment. This fundamental condition can bring it, therefore, much closer to the viewer’s own situation than can the image.

zh: 诺曼·布赖森
en: Norman Bryson

zh: 对艺术史——一门奠基于十九世纪民族主义的学科——而言，“语境”意味着什么？在这门学科中，地点、时间与风格相互定位，在不同历史时刻构成一个连贯的启发式框架：1945年之后、1973年之后，以及再次的现在？我们又当如何找到术语，来描述在艺术博览会与双年展、在既有博物馆与资产阶级公共领域（如尤尔根·哈贝马斯所称）的建制中遭遇的众多零散而显然互不相关的潮流中，当代艺术的流行趋向——尽管在全球资本之下，“资产阶级”的含义正如“语境”一词一样迅速变化？这两个问题看似无关，直到一种模式开始显现，暗示着一个问题对另一个问题的依赖。图表就是这些问题在其中汇聚、或被表明早已缠绕在一起的（审美）操作。这一图形实践模式早在两次世界大战之间的历史先锋派中便已运作（布朗库西、杜尚、毕卡比亚），并在过去六十年中升至主导地位：皮耶罗·曼佐尼、温琴佐·阿涅蒂、巴里·弗拉纳根、汉斯·哈克、马塞尔·布达埃尔、多萝西娅·罗克伯恩、理查德·汉密尔顿、阿格尼丝·德内斯、南希·霍尔特、李·洛扎诺、安娜·玛丽亚·马约利诺、理查德·塔特尔、马克·隆巴迪、加布里埃尔·奥罗斯科、埃伦·加拉格尔、威廉·肯特里奇、卡拉·沃克、克里斯托瓦尔·莱特、朱莉·梅赫雷图、丹尼尔·泽勒与 Nobuya Hoki。
en: What does ‘context’ mean for art history, a discipline founded in the nationalisms of the nineteenth century, wherein place, time and style have triangulated to form a coherent heuristic frame at different historical moments: after 1945, after 1973 and again now? And how do we find the terms to describe prevailing tendencies in contemporary art among the numerous scattered and apparently unrelated trends encountered at art fairs and biennials, and in established museums and institutions of the bourgeois public sphere, as Jürgen Habermas called it, although what ‘bourgeois’ means under global capital is shifting as rapidly as the term ‘context’? These two questions appear unrelated until a pattern begins to emerge suggesting the dependence of one question on the other. The diagram is one (aesthetic) operation within which the questions converge, or are shown to be already entwined. Already operative in the historical avant-gardes of the interwar period (Brancusi, Duchamp, Picabia), this modality of graphic practice has risen to dominance over the last sixty years: Piero Manzoni, Vincenzo Agnetti, Barry Flanagan, Hans Haacke, Marcel Broodthaers, Dorothea Rockburne, Richard Hamilton, Agnes Denes, Nancy Holt, Lee Lozano, Anna Maria Maiolino, Richard Tuttle, Mark Lombardi, Gabriel Orozco, Ellen Gallagher, William Kentridge, Kara Walker, Cristobal Lehyt, Julie Mehretu, Daniel Zeller and Nobuya Hoki.

zh: 或许，比艺术史“方法”问题更为根本地，语境问题对批评构成压力，因为艺术实践已经表明，世界的“解域”与“再域化”在多大程度上影响了再现形式（如素描）得以连贯并产生意义——得以展示并讲述这个“世界”——的基本可用性。

于是，图表或线的指示功能兴起了。线被赋予传达数据与信息的任务，而非建立轮廓、把图形与背景分开并呈现再现的基本要素——这曾是它的历史功能。再现的基本工具在我们所认识的那些旧形式无法表征的世界变化之后被表明失效，这本身已是需要新形式与新术语的极端症候。艺术与精微的文化生产预兆性地症候化了那些尚无法清晰表述的剧烈转变：它们先发生于经济领域，随后开始在社会场域中回荡。它做到这一点的方式，是挪用／再挪用那些传统上属于理性化形式的装置，如图表；这些理性化形式曾是所谓“基础”相对于“上层建筑”的根基。
无论这一过程的描述显得多么循环，艺术生产都是原因与效果回路上的一个位置，可在那里定位时间之真实运动、以及与资源、价值和社会再生产之代谢交换的病因学。
en: Running more fundamentally, perhaps, than even the question of art-historical ‘method’, the question of context presses on criticism given that art practices have shown the degree to which the ‘de-’ and ‘reterritorialization’ of the world have affected the basic availability of forms of representation, such as drawing, to cohere and to make sense – to show and to tell about this ‘world’.

And so one sees the rise of the diagram or indexical functions of line. Line is tasked to convey data, information, rather than to establish contour, divide a figure from ground, and present the rudiments of representation, its historical function. That the basic tools of representation are shown to fail in the wake of world changes that exceed their own representability by the old forms as we recognize them is already an extreme symptom of the need for new forms and new terms. Art and rarified cultural production presciently symptomatize the yet inarticulable seismic shifts that occur first in the economic sphere, then begin to resonate throughout the social field. It does so by means of appropriating/reappropriating the very devices, such as of the diagram, which traditionally belong to forms of rationalization foundational to what was once known as the ‘base’ in relation to a ‘superstructure’.

Circular as the description of this process may seem, artistic production is one place along a circuit of cause and effect to locate an aetiology of the real movement of time and the metabolic exchange with resources, value and social reproduction.

zh: 图表常被挪用为一种认知测绘的形式。它取代了欧洲艺术史上所理解的素描。素描曾是再现的基石，把充盈的视觉场分解为图形与背景，随后保证所描绘身体相对于空间包膜的完整性。线性形式的生产与操控能力长期被视为技艺的基石，到二十世纪初也已成为一种表现能力的载体——在维也纳与中欧语境中尤其如此，那里深受浪漫主义影响。正如莫莉·内斯比特在《Their Common Sense》中有力论证的，杜尚式现成品——克劳斯的“理论对象”——是工业设计的功能。
内斯比特指出，杜尚那一代是法国公立学校体系中第一批被强制教授设计素描的人，表面上的目的是培养工程师与工厂工人。无论如何，图表的特殊可供性双重地重新引入了生产代谢与艺术力比多经济之间的困难关系。
它的能力在于表达诸项之间运动的独特辩证法，既在历时性层面、即历史性层面上，又在结构并决定任何主体对现代性总体之把握过程的静止层面。它测绘主体化过程。更确切地说，它把主体化过程测绘为一种与物化紧密相关但并不等同于物化的过程，预示了朗西埃在《阅读〈资本论〉》中关于主体与生产、与其对象即商品、并最终与价值形式和市场抽象之间迂回而中介化之关系的主张。
en: The diagram is often appropriated as a form of cognitive mapping. It displaces drawing as it had been understood in the history of European art. Drawing had been the cornerstone of representation, breaking the visual plenum into figure and ground, then guaranteeing the integrity of a depicted body against the envelope of space. Long understood to be a cornerstone of skill, the capacity to produce and manipulate linear form had also by the opening of the twentieth century come to be a vehicle of expressive capacity, notably in the Viennese and central European context with its debt to Romanticism. As Molly Nesbit convincingly argues in
, the Duchampian readymade – Krauss’s ‘theoretical object’ – is a function of industrial design.

Nesbit notes that Duchamp’s gen eration was the first to be taught mandatory drawing-for-design in the French public-school system, ostensibly to train engineers and factory workers alike. Be that as it may, the diagram’s special affordance doubly reintroduced the difficult relation between the metabolic of production and the libidinal economy of art.

Its capacity to express the singular dialectic of movement among terms on both a diachronic register, or that of historicity, and the stasis structuring and determining the process by which any subjective grasp on the totality of modernity could be made. It maps the process of subjectivization. More to the point, it maps the process of subjectivization as one bound up with, but not identical to, reification, anticipating Rancière’s claims in
about the subject’s circuitous and mediated relation to production, to its object the commodity, and ultimately to the value form and abstraction of the market.

zh: 二十世纪早期的先锋派并不缺少先见之明，尤其是在“语境”的解域方面——“语境”曾是“艺术史”的基石——以及向图表之无界无边的经济的转变方面。未来主义、达达，以及二者相遇所产生的各种混杂体，似乎为晚于它们的时代、也就是我们的当下，充当了一种辩证的研究与开发。另一种表述方式是借用杰里米·吉尔伯特为毛里齐奥·拉扎拉托论杜尚现成品——作为不生产价值的管理劳动的化身——之分析所写序言中的术语，说它们，即先锋派，已经
了它们的未来，也就是我们的当下。
en: The avant-gardes of the early twentieth century demonstrate no shortage of clairvoyance, not least with relation to the deterritorialization of ‘context’, once the bedrock of ‘art history’, and the shift to the boundless and borderless economy of the diagram. Futurism, Dada and the assorted hybrids generated of their mutual encounters seem to have acted as a form of dialectical research and development for the era post-dating them, which is to say our current moment. Another way to formulate the thought would be to borrow a term from Jeremy Gilbert’s preface to Maurizio Lazzarato’s analysis of the Duchampian readymade as avatar to non-value productive managerial labour and say that they, the avant-gardes, have
it their future and our present.

zh: 自1960年代起，图表与图解在众多当代实践中日益压过图像，是实在界层面剧烈变化的强烈症候。艺术，尤其在其最自主的时候，在变化于话语中被象征化和形式化之前，便预演并症候化了实在领域中的变化。
en: From the 1960s on, that the chart and diagram increasingly overtake the image in many contemporary practices is a strong symptom of seismic changes on the register of the real. Art, especially when it is most autonomous, prefigures and symptomatizes changes in the field of the real before they are symbolized and formalized in discourse.

zh: 然而，图表式思维早在1960年代之前就已在艺术中被动员。人们早已针对构成主义及二十世纪初的其他实践指出：“图表线虽取自科学与技术制图的领域……最终作品却具有记谱的要素。作品并不‘再现世界’（如果这指的是具象艺术所用的模型），而是通过联想、材料、方法的流通，包含对生产它的世界的暗示。”

也许较少被阐发的是，这一转变在多大程度上回荡于整个世纪，并取代具象，使实在与其接受之间、或基础与上层建筑之间中介过程中那些否则无法描绘、不可见的转变变得可感知。此处的关键，是线被期待传达意义之层面的转变。以记谱取代轮廓与模仿，这一处于基本视觉实践核心的转变，标示出与内容及意义在根本层面上的分解和重组之间更为深刻的关系，或许并非不像图像在技术可复制性之后所经历的转变——如本雅明著名描述的那样。本文的赌注是：语境的（不）连贯性，乘着晚期资本主义现代性中图表问题的浪潮而来。
en: However, diagrammatic thinking was mobilized in art well before the 1960s. It has long been noted with reference to constructivism and other practices of the early twentieth century that while ‘the diagrammatic line is drawn from the realm of science and technical drawing … the final work has elements of notation. The works do not “represent the world” if that is taken to be the model used in figurative art, but they contain allusions to the world in which they were produced by the currency of associations, materials, methods.’

Less elaborated, perhaps, is the degree to which the shift reverberates through the century and, replacing figuration, renders perceptible otherwise unfigurable and invisible shifts in the mediation between the real and its reception, or between the base and the superstructure. The key here is the shift in the register within which line is expected to deliver meaning. Replacing contour and mimesis with notation, this transition at the heart of basic visual practice signals a more profound relation to the de- and recomposition of content and meaning at a fundamental level, perhaps not unlike the transition the image underwent in the wake of technological reproducibility, as famously described by Benjamin. It is the gambit of this essay that the in/coherence of context rides in on the question of the diagram in late capitalist modernity.

zh: 把这些先锋派联结起来的唯一因素，是它们对大众主体、对普通人以及“他”作为大众主体进入历史舞台——无论自觉与否——的执拗关注。哈尔·福斯特以一个问题总结这一病因学，自2008年、上一轮重大资本主义危机开始之际读到他的《义肢之神》以来，我一直反复回到这个问题：“未来主义会不会并不像它看起来那样异常？会不会此时盛期现代主义的真正赌注，恰恰涉及与物化和死亡的赌局？”
这一赌局是否可能采取图表的形式与运作方式？我在此的主张是：毕卡比亚——甚至早于杜尚，尽管我对起源神话或对原创性的所有权主张不感兴趣——以图表的运动取代了图像与符号、图画与词语（分别是图像再现与诗学中模仿的基石），图表在此测绘欲望关系并铭刻一种社会动力学。
en: The single factor binding these avant-gardes was their obsessive preoccupation with the mass subject, with the everyman and ‘his’ entry qua mass subject onto the arena of history, consciously or otherwise. Hal Foster concludes this aetiology with a question that I have returned to since reading his

in 2008, at the beginning of the last major round of capitalist crisis: ‘could it be that Futurism is not as aberrant as it appears? Could it be that the very stake of high modernism at this time involves wagers with reification and death?’

Might this wager take the form and operational mode of a diagram? My claim here is that Picabia, before even Duchamp – although I am not interested in origin myths or property claims to originality – displaces both icon and symbol, both picture and word (the cornerstones of mimesis in pictorial representation and poetics respectively), for the movement of the diagram as it charts relations of desire and inscribes a social dynamic.

zh: 在弗朗西斯·毕卡比亚的《普遍的卖淫》（1916—17）与杜尚的《Tu m’》（1918）中，图表是一种经济运动的索引，这种经济被一条在词语与图像之下如河流般奔涌的力比多经济所联结又所阻遏。杜尚此时与毕卡比亚密切合作；毕卡比亚的《没有母亲的女孩》（1917）、二人各自的《L.H.O.O.Q.》（均完成于1919年），以及毕卡比亚1920年的《年轻女孩（机械形态）》——合起来不过少数几件作品——构成进入这一术语星丛的入口：物化、主体化、经由价值形式的抽象。杜尚的《Tu m’》展示了一系列实验：现成品及相关偶然性策略，通过自行车轮等著名现成品的投影，以指示方式呈现。
en: The diagram is an index of the movements of an economy articulated and thwarted by a libidinal economy coursing like a river below words and pictures, in Francis Picabia’s
(1916–17) and Duchamp’s
(1918). Duchamp was at this time working closely with Picabia, whose

of 1920 – together, a handful works – constitute a point of entry into the constellation of terms: reification, subjectivization, abstraction-by-value-form. Duchamp’s
showcases a range of the artist’s experiments with the readymade and related strategies of contingency presented indexically through cast shadows of well-known readymades such as the bicycle wheel.

zh: 表面上看，1917年的《没有母亲的女孩》与1920年的《年轻女孩（机械形态）》似乎把资本主义内部作为一个主体的状况——在自我构成的分子层面上以被遮蔽的方式从属

资本——字面化了。前者在未分化的金色底子上描绘机器部件。它以一种暗示精神分析在“移置”名目下所理论化的机制的方式，调换了图形与背景的关系：图像的基底意指金钱。从文艺复兴早期到西方艺术近代早期，金色一直是映照赞助人财富的方式。于是，金钱是以它为背景的“图形”——机器或“女孩”——的母体；这女孩“没有母亲”，起源非生物学，母体被工厂车间的转喻性符码取代。自动机与非人占了上风。《年轻女孩》作为《女孩》的佐证，是一幅肖像，就所描绘的对象充满画面而言——这种类型惯例由拉斐尔1510年的《巴尔达萨雷·卡斯蒂利奥内肖像》确立。机器部件的通用工业再现充满画面，垂直升向墙面与画面，召唤绘画作品的反思性。但所展示的东西不过如此，一件随意之物。在它下方，“For-Ever”一词漂浮着，仿佛要保证这件奇怪肖像之物的在场；但当然，从立体主义学会了语言课程之后，这词只锚定画面场域的平面性与物的非现实性。然而那物确实昭示了现代个体，以及其奇异地被抽空的、对自身在场性的承诺票据——它永远无法兑现。

作为连接视觉信息以及物、词语、质地与概念的图表，毕卡比亚另一件由马塞尔·杜尚购得并遗赠耶鲁大学美术馆的杰作《普遍的卖淫》，重复了那些机器部件形式。一个部件立在画面左侧，以完美的塑形与明暗对照法描绘；其他部件散落在视觉表面上。词语从机器中发出，像工厂传送带上的货物一样交叉，水平滑动，与呼应画框垂直上升的机器部件图像志形成张力。一条看似弦或线的物事从主要机器部件伸向其他部件。这些部件虽以三维方式表现，仿佛能占据三维空间，却在真空之中，衬着平坦而未分化的虚空。其平面性再次被横穿表面的词语所确认。

capital at the molecular level of the constitution of the self. The first represents machine parts against an undifferentiated gold ground. Switching out figure and ground relations in a way suggestive of mechanisms theorized by psychoanalysis under the rubric of displacement, the ground of the image denotes money. Gold, from the early Renaissance to the early modern period of Western art, had been a way to reflect the wealth of the patron. Money, then, is the matrix of the ‘figure’ against it, the machine or ‘girl’ born ‘without a mother’, of non-biological origins where the maternal body is replaced by the metonymic cipher of the factory floor. Automata and the inhuman have prevailed.

, is a portrait in so far as the object figured fills the frame in a genre convention set by Raphael in his

of 1510. A generic industrial representation of machine parts fills the frame, rising vertically to the wall and picture plane to summon the reflexivity of the pictorial work. But the thing shown is just that, a random thing. Under it, the words ‘For-Ever’ float as though to guarantee the presence of this strange portrait-thing, but of course, having learned the lessons of language from cubism, the words anchor only the flatness of the picture place and the unreality of the thing. And yet that thing figures forth the modern individual and its strangely evacuated promissory note of being present to itself, which it can never rise to meet.
A diagram connecting visual information as well as things, words, textures and concepts, Picabia’s other great work, purchased by Marcel Duchamp and bequeathed to Yale University Art Gallery,

, repeats those machine part forms. One stands left of field, depicted in perfect modelling and chiaroscuro; others are strewn over the visual surface. Words issue from the machine and cross like goods on the factory belt, sliding horizontally in tension against the iconography of a machine part that echoes the vertical rise of the frame. What appears to be a chord or wire stretches from the main machine part to the other. While the parts are represented in three dimensions, as though capable of occupying three-dimensional space, they do so in a vacuum, against a flat and undifferentiated void. Its flatness is once again ratified by the words that cross the surface.

zh: 换言之，毕卡比亚那幅奇怪的图表，或许更应被理解为对现代性中重新分配身份与财产含义之社会关系的演示，即物化，而非对机器部件——物——的拜物化；俄意未来主义在等价与价值形式体制下对感官全面钙化的表演中，正是把机器部件拜物化了。
en: Picabia’s strange diagram, in other words, might be understood more as a demonstration of the social relations redistributing the meaning of identity and property in modernity, namely reification, than the machine parts – objects – fetishized by Russian and Italian Futurisms in the latter’s performance of the total calcification of the senses under the regime of equivalence and the value form.

zh: 朗西埃在重读《资本论》时，建立在阿尔都塞及其他人的工作之上，他们追问资本主义相对于人类利益的自主性与冷漠。朗西埃提出一种资本主义内部的主体理论：主体既是资本结构性自我复制的载体，又是对资本主义所必需之社会结构的中断：“决定诸效果之间关系的，是原因（社会生产关系），就其
而言。”在此，朗西埃对马克思所谓“生产的隐秘居所”作了必要的致意。然而，他在这里把它作为缺席的原因引入。这一缺席的原因不是作为主体的劳动。毋宁说，它是抽象劳动相对于具体劳动的非同一性。“这一缺席的原因不是作为主体的劳动，而是抽象劳动与具体劳动的同一性，因为其普遍化表达了某种生产方式——资本主义生产方式——的结构。
en: Building on the work of Althusser and others who interrogate capitalism’s autonomy from and indifference to human interest in their rereading of

, Rancière offers a theory of the subject within capitalism as both a vehicle to capital’s structural self-replication and an interruption to a social structure necessary to capitalism: ‘what determines the relation between the effects is the cause (social relations of production) insofar as it is

.’ Here, Rancière gives the requisite nod to the ‘hidden abode of production’ as Marx called it. Here, however, he introduces it as absent cause. This absent cause is not labour as a subject as such. Rather, it is the non-identity of abstract labour in relationship to concrete labour. ‘This absent cause is not labour as a subject, it is the identity of abstract labour and concrete labour inasmuch as its generalization expresses the structure of a certain mode of production, the capitalist mode of production.

zh: 换言之，不存在分析的对象。存在的只是一组关系：工人、他或她的劳动能力，以及体现于他或她参与制造的产品中的劳动之间的关系。在资本主义生产方式中，没有哪个特定场所或身份是资本的生成之处；剩余资本是关系的功能。不存在经验上可证实的肯定性身份。
en: In other words, there is no object of analysis. Rather, there is only a set of relations among the worker, his or her capacity for work and the work expressed in products he or she is part of making. There is no particular site or identity in the capitalist mode of production from which capital is generated; surplus capital is a function of relations. There is no empirically verifiable positive identity.

children: 资本本身是一种图表功能。资本主义是诸运动与过渡之间的关系。
Capital itself is a diagrammatic function. Capitalism is a relationship among movements and transitions.

zh: 这一裂隙——作为人的劳动者、他或她的劳动力、以及商品中耗费的劳动时间之间——作为劳动普遍化的场所运作。它是一种围绕缺席结构起来的故障，生成着相对于它而组织起来的社会关系。如此，它把资本主义生产方式表达为一种缺席与差异的结构，一种围绕具体劳动与抽象劳动之间裂隙组织起来的社会关系。这一缺席的原因不是工作，而是劳动力——被对象化、被度量、匿名的劳动力，利润的关键——进入社会场域的方式：它伪装成个体，以一种拟人化的层面被社会地呈现，把具体劳动的承担者与其承载劳动的能力（价值的来源）混为一谈。社会场域错失的事实是：劳动的抽象尺度及其市场上的销售点——在那里它同时被抽象化和实现——并不等同于劳动者，后者身处由与他人的关系所规定的日常生活中。被抽象并交换／实现的劳动悬置了劳动力承担者个人的和集体的经验，以一种“第二自然”取代它，而这一“第二自然”由交换过程本身自然化；在此过程中，经验性的东西被抽空，以榨取价值。
朗西埃如此解释劳动能力感知中的这一故障：它被困在一个间隙里，在此，人或劳动力的承担者被等同于劳动力带来利润的能力，而人的其他品质与轨迹则被遮蔽：“内在结构规定的倒转表现为过程的一个基本特征。正是这一规律决定了其形式的发展。”
简言之，朗西埃在此提供了一种物化理论，对格奥尔格·卢卡奇的理论作了细化。
en: This gap, between the labourer as a person, his or her labour-power, and the labour time expended in the commodity, operates as the site of generalization of labour. It is a kind of glitch structured around absence which generates social relations organized in relation to it. As such it expresses the capitalist mode of production as a structure of absence and difference, of social relations organized around a gap between concrete and abstract labour. This absent cause is not work, but the way in which labour-power, objectified and metricized and anonymous, the key to profit, enters the social field disguised as the individual, presented socially in an anthropomorphic register that conflates the bearer of concrete labour with her or his labour-bearing capacity (the source of value). The social field misses the fact that the abstract measure of labour and its point of sale on the market – where it becomes at once abstracted and realized – is not the same thing as the labourer, situated as s/he is in a daily life determined by relations with others. The labour abstracted and exchanged/realized suspends the personal and collective experience of the bearer of labour-power, replacing it with a ‘second nature’ naturalized thus by the process of exchange itself, in which the experiential is evacuated in the interest of deriving value.

Rancière explains this glitch in the perception of labour- power, caught in an interval where the person or bearer of labour-power becomes equated with the profit-bearing capacity of labour-power to the occlusion of the other qualities and trajectory of the human: ‘The inversion of the inner structural determinations appears as a fundamental characteristic of the process. It is this law that determines the development of its forms.’
In short, Rancière here provides a theory of reification that nuances that of Georg Lukács.

zh: 毕卡比亚在《L.H.O.O.Q.》（1919）中拾起图表作为形式装置。这是对杜尚同年同名卑下唯物主义作品的对话式回应：杜尚作品中，《蒙娜丽莎》的复制品被加上胡须和山羊胡，标题字母横穿下部区域，快速读出会在法语中听起来像“她有个火辣的屁股”——以粗俗幽默和一丝被贬低又贬低他人的欲望，多半是为震惊中产阶级，打断了它在西方艺术万神殿中的神圣性。毕卡比亚的版本则以几何级数更加令人不安，也更为激进。它把人物想象为图表或某种地图：
（易碎）与

en: Picabia picks up the diagram as a formal device in

Picabia’s version is exponentially more disturbing, and radical. It imagines the figure as a diagram or a kind of map: the words

It resembles a diagram of movement of the kind Jacques Lacan would draw to figure the subject as a function of an opaque movement among moments or stations, which he called the real, imaginary and symbolic.

zh: 动员从轮廓转向图表的艺术实践名单横跨整个世纪，从1915年到2016年。我们可以带有倾向性地把这些实践定位为众多文化实例，标示图表作为启发式装置被纯粹审美地挪用、并加以精炼和发展的过程。
en: The list of artistic practices that mobilize the turn from contour to diagram crosses the century, from 1915 to 2016. We could tendentiously situate these practices as so many cultural instances marking the elaboration and development of the purely aesthetic appropriation of the diagram as a heuristic device.

zh: 但这一文化发展的展开，反过来可以被表明追踪着一种平行的双重运动：文化嵌套于资本主义生产方式解体及全球资源与人口再整合所带来的运动之中，并与之相对。虽然不可能把一方（图表的内部
）映射到另一方（资本主义吸纳的历史性）上，一种模式仍然浮现。在没有任何因果关联的情况下，线的转变仍然标记着资本主义贫困化的进程，以及进步诸时刻之间的过渡点。仿佛线的解域以某种方式指示性地记录了认知测绘与“全球化”——资本主义的另一个名字——同步的分解与重组。在下文中，我挑出这样一项实践，尝试把它读作实在抽象的索引。
en: But this unfolding of a cultural development, in turn, could be shown to track a parallel, double movement of culture nested in and against the movement brought about by the disintegration of the capitalist mode of production and the reintegration of global resources and demographics. While it would be impossible to map the one (the internal

of the diagram) onto the other (the historicity of capitalist subsumption), a pattern nonetheless emerges. In the absence of any causal correlation, the transformation of line nevertheless marks the progress of capitalist immiseration and the transitional points between moments of progress. It is as though the deterritorialization of line somehow recorded, indexically, the de- and recomposition of cognitive mapping ‘in line’ with ‘globalization’, itself another name for capitalism. In what follows, I isolate one such practice and attempt to read it as an index of real abstraction.

Manzoni: reiteration and elaboration of the avant-garde

zh: 二十世纪中叶，曼佐尼的《线》（1959）激进化了现代主义——从杜尚到阿多诺再到凯奇——对艺术过程之禁欲式还原的关注，尤其是把素描从前被设想和实践为展示技艺的手段，转化为其他能动性形式。
en: In the mid-twentieth century, Manzoni’s

(1959) radicalized the modernist preoccupation – from Duchamp to Adorno to Cage – with the ascetic reduction of artistic process, particularly the transformation of drawing, formerly conceived and practised as a means to demonstrate skill, into other modalities of agency.

zh: 每一次“线”的呈现都由一个硬纸板圆筒、一卷画有黑线的纸，以及一张简单印刷并签名的标签组成，标签上简要说明作品：艺术家姓名、创作日期及其长度。这件探讨线本身之可能性的作品，通过对工厂车间中生产价值的劳动的模仿性铭刻，思考作出痕迹的条件如何在规训性日常生活所强加的预定系统中逐渐消失。换言之，艺术作品展示了规训性劳动如何不可避免地限制那些被认为超越经济决定之低俗事务的、历史上确立的文化形式。《线》辩证地、否定地从艺术家的视角把问题置于前景；艺术家在阶级认同上远非工人，却被期待在资本主义价值逻辑所管理的独裁规定之内并与之对抗地交付意识。制造与作者身份同样被网状化，专属于同一种普遍等价形式，而不顾工人类型之间众多质的差异。《线》从制造的角度设定“自我反思性”——现代主义的支柱——以及在一个为抽象价值而加速的时代中艺术能动性那日益消失的可能性。
en: Each presentation of ‘line’ consists of a cardboard tube, a scroll of paper with a black line drawn down it, and a simple printed and autographed label, which contains a brief description of the work: the artist’s name, the date it was created and its length. This work about the very possibility of line thinks through the vanishing conditions of mark-making within predetermined systems enforced by disciplinary everyday life in mimetic inscription to value-productive labour on the factory floor. In other words, the work of art demonstrates the way in which disciplinary labour comes inevitably to limit historically established forms of culture believed to transcend lowly matters of economic determination.

dialectically, and negatively, foregrounds the problem from the point of view of the artist, who, while far from the worker in terms of class identification, was expected to deliver consciousness within and against the dictatorial determinations managed by the capitalist logic of value. Manufacture and authorship alike came to be reticulated exclusively to the same form of general equivalence, irrespective of the numerous qualitative differences among types of workers. The
posit ‘self-reflexivity’ – that linchpin of modernism – in terms of manufacture, and the vanishing possibility of artistic agency in an era accelerated in the interest of abstracted value.

zh: 一如既往，阿多诺擅长把吸纳问题转译回文化术语；霸权的自由主义文化中介着同样的过程，并使它们合法化。“资产阶级社会由等价原则统治。它把不同事物还原为抽象数量，从而使它们可比。对启蒙而言，凡不能被还原为数字、并最终还原为一的东西，都是幻象；现代实证主义把它交托给诗。”

然而，由剩余价值榨取所产生的社会关系——它本身是由价值榨取过程所结构之链条的效果——本身已经是一种多样性，一种无法被分解为任何经验上稳定要素的复合体。早在1929年，在为《法兰克福报》写作时，西格弗里德·克拉考尔就观察到，现代工厂的运作除了通过图表之外无法被确定：“在参观视察之前，一家现代工厂的商务总监向我解释业务。……他指着图表，上面彩色的线条说明整个运作。”然而这一整个运作却沿着一个枢纽性的缺席运行：“多亏投入设备的智力劳动，它的女仆们得以免于拥有知识；如果商业学院的课程不是义务的，她们根本什么都不需要知道。公司的奥秘对她们是一本合上的书。”
这不只是说工人不知道自己所卷入的、从开端到利润的整个过程总体；而是仿佛她们必须不知道。
en: As ever, Adorno is adept at translating the issue of subsumption back into cultural terms; hegemonic liberal culture mediates the same processes, legitimating them. ‘Bourgeois society is ruled by equivalence. It makes dissimilar things comparable by reducing them to abstract quantities. For the Enlightenment, anything which cannot be resolved into numbers, and ultimately into one, is illusion; modern positivism consigns it to poetry.’

And yet the social relations generated of the extraction of surplus value, itself the effect of a chain structured by the process of value extraction, is itself already a multiplicity, a complex that cannot be resolved into any empirically stable terms. Already in 1929, writing for the

, Siegfried Kracauer observed the way in which the operations of the modern factory cannot be pinned down other than through a diagram: ‘The commercial director of a modern factory explains business to me before my tour of the inspection. … He points to diagrams whose colourful lines illustrate the whole operation.’ And yet this whole operation moves along a pivotal absence: ‘Thanks to the intellectual labour invested in the equipment, its handmaidens are spared the possession of knowledge; if attendance at commercial college were not compulsory, they would need to know nothing at all. The mysteries of the firm are a closed book to them.’
It is not simply that workers do not know the totality of the process in which they are implicated, from inception to profit; it is as though they must not know.

zh: 曼佐尼模仿这些由资本主义生产方式所结构的关系状况——在其中，价值在关系网络之外没有确定的内容或起源——在米兰一家工厂的装配线上“制作”了《线》。他坐在传送带上，手持蘸了墨的画笔，一个机械轮送入一卷纸，纸触到他的笔，产生一条线。他被动留下的痕迹被抽空了任何技艺或情感性的在场，把去技能化的体力劳动折叠进特权的在场空间：艺术家的痕迹。线对任何表现性、感官性、力比多内容的取消（从超现实主义到表现主义，线的作用晚近已从模仿再现中的工具性角色解放出来），与夸张的包装形成张力，暗示作品对匿名主体——工人／制作者——的嵌入性依赖；这个主体的实体痕迹生成了产品本身的参数，而产品又折返回来取消这一在场。确实，
。我们可以称之为关于商品拜物教前提的实物教学课——它把人变成物，把能动性归于物——但其中比这还要多一点，也少一点。最终作品浮现于以下诸者之间的间隙：机器、艺术家—工人、把这一
劳动提供出售的包装，以及通过签名功能确认其为艺术作品的市场。
en: Mimicking these relational conditions structured by the capitalist mode of production in which value has no certain content or origin outside of a network of relations, Manzoni ‘made’ the

on an assembly line in a factory in Milan. He sat on a conveyor belt holding an ink-stained brush while a mechanical wheel fed a scroll of paper touching his brush to produce a line. His passive mark, vacated of any kind of skilled or emotive presence, folds deskilled manual labour into the privileged space of presence: the artist’s mark. The line’s foreclosure of any expressive, sensual, libidinal content (the role of line from surrealism through expressionism, having been lately liberated from its instrumental role in mimetic representation), set into tension with exaggerated packaging, implies the work’s embedded dependence on an anonymous subject, the worker/ maker whose substantive trace generates the parameters of the very product that doubles back to cancel that presence. Indeed,

. We could call this an object lesson in the preconditions of the commodity fetish that makes things of people and ascribes agency to things, but there’s a little more and a little less to it than this. The resulting work emerges in the gap among the machine, the artist-worker, the packaging that offers for sale this
labour and the market that affirms it as an artwork through the function of a signature.

This use of modernist hermetic withdrawal nevertheless yields to a frustrated acknowledgement of the active erasure, rather than ontological withdrawal, of both content and agency. Manzoni shifts register from Heidegger back to Marx: not

zh: 朗西埃指出，在围绕缺席、或劳动者与劳动力之间、一般抽象劳动与最终在剩余价值中表现的具体劳动之间的故障所结构的偶然社会关系中，现实变得“思辨性”。
它成为社会行动者与物之间偶然关系运动的功能，这些关系可沿图表被测绘。现在回到抽象与图表这一更大的问题：如果“实在抽象”不是物化的另一个术语，还会是什么？它由工资、匿名劳动与商品这三驾马车在日常生活中带来的存在论转变所标示。

这些存在论转变如何在时间中运动？“金融化”、“后福特主义”、乃至“后现代主义”这些术语暗示一种序列，无论每个术语多么准确或错误。它们描述工人、群众与大众在世界各地感受并承受的政治经济现实中的一系列发展——用任何别的名字称呼它，它生成一种常被称作“新自由主义”的状况。什么是新自由主义？在《新自由主义简史》中，大卫·哈维论证说，这个术语描述的是一系列事件的结果，即在巩固国际货币基金组织（IMF）、世界银行、世界贸易组织（WTO）与华尔街之间关系的过程中的结果。
en: Rancière notes that within the contingent social relations structured around absence, or a glitch between the labourer and labour-power, and between abstract labour in general and concrete labour expressed finally expressed in surplus value, reality becomes ‘speculative’.

It becomes a function of the movement of the contingent relations among social agents and objects that might be charted along a diagram. Returning now to the larger problem of abstraction and the diagram, what is ‘real abstraction’ if not just another term for reification, signalled by the ontological shifts in everyday life brought about by the triumvirate of wage, anonymous labour and the commodity?

How do these ontological shifts move in time? The terms ‘financialization’, ‘post-Fordism’, even ‘post-modernism’ suggest a sequence, however accurate or erroneous each may be. They describe a succession of developments in the political-economic reality felt and suffered by workers, masses and multitudes all over the world, one by any other name, one that generates a condition frequently evoked as ‘neoliberalism’. What is neoliberalism? In

, David Harvey argues that the term describes the result of a succession of events in the consolidation of the relationship between the IMF (International Monetary Fund), the World Bank, the WTO (World Trade Organization) and Wall Street.

zh: 新自由主义化的过程带来了大量创造性毁灭，不仅针对先前的制度框架与权力（甚至挑战传统的国家主权形式），也针对劳动分工、社会关系、福利供给、技术组合、生活方式与思想方式、再生产活动、对土地的依恋以及心灵的习惯。
en: The process of neoliberalization has entailed much creative  destruction not only of prior institutional frameworks and powers  (even challenging traditional forms of state sovereignty) but also  divisions of labour, social relations, welfare provisions, technological  mixes, ways of life and thought, reproductive activities, attachments  to the land and habits of heart.

zh: 针对一种叙事——即一系列国家与制度联盟把全球警治为所谓“新自由主义”——许多人指出，资本主义的深远触及在结构上不可避免，是资本主义积累周期需要更大领土以供劳动与资源开采的逻辑结果。晚近的危机资本主义理论（它们回到罗莎·卢森堡、格奥尔格·卢卡奇等人的较早理论）挑战哈维的论述，指出资本主义的基本结构状况，即需要保持领先于其内在的利润率下降倾向。
而这一倾向正是产生利润所必需的贫困化的核心，
资本能把资源与劳动来源吸收进自己的机器，以助长其自身的结构性熵，从而回到与哈维因果性路径不同的资本主义论述。例如，保罗·马蒂克在《照常营业》中的论题坚持结构优先于全球治理与管制机构之间次级政治谈判的展开，构成对哈维的纠正。但问题不在于哪位马克思主义名家比另一位更好，而在于各自试图描述和分期那些
的新兴状况时敞开的空白。
en: Against the narrative according to which a succession of state and institutional alliances policed the globe into so-called ‘neoliberalism’, many note that the far reach of capitalism is structurally inevitable, the logical outcome of capitalism’s cycles of accumulation necessitating greater territories to be mined for labour and resources. Recent theories (which return to older theories such as those of Rosa Luxemburg, Georg Lukács and others) of crisis capitalism challenge Harvey’s account by pointing to the basic structural condition of capitalism, namely the need to keep ahead of its inherent tendency of falling profits.
And this very tendency is at the heart of the immiseration necessary for generating profits,

capital can absorb resources and sources of labour into its machinery to abet its own structural entropy, thereby returning to accounts of capitalism at odds with Harvey’s approach to causality. Paul Mattick’s thesis in

, for instance, acts as a corrective to Harvey in its insistence on structure over the unfolding of secondary political negotiations among global bodies of governance and regulation. But the question is not what Marxian luminary is better than the other, but rather the lacunae that open up in how each tries to describe and periodize emergent conditions

zh: 问题在历史宏大叙事的最大尺度上被提出。记着詹姆森的“永远总体化！”，我既依赖大卫·哈维的工作，也依赖乔瓦尼·阿里吉、罗伯特·布伦纳等人；他们提出了在全球化力量、尤其是金融化力量造成复杂化之后思考历史因果性的方式，而金融化已开始决定通信网络，并重塑我们所指的时间、地点与原因。

对哈维、阿里吉、布伦纳等人而言（尽管有众多差异），1973年的石油危机是第一世界国家保持高利润战略的信号性时刻；这些战略如今被我们用未经检视的简写称作“全球化”：欠发达世界的廉价劳动力、从福特主义转向后福特主义生产技术、强调供应链甚于工厂车间中的生产，以更高效地榨取利润（更少承担劳动成本），更不用说在新经济中、在危机导致增长停滞后，国际货币基金组织在撒切尔—里根年代所实施的新一轮原始积累。我们需要通过文化生产提供的病因学，描述并追踪这个由资本主义价值增殖形式所带来的复杂规定的马蜂窝——它们以人口在全球的大规模流动为前提。哈维所谓的“解域”与“再域化”——由日常生活在发达资本的支配下的创造性毁灭与再巩固所强制执行——改变了语境与因果性的根本概念。
en: The problem is posed on the largest scale of a historical grand narrative. With Jameson’s ‘Always totalize!’ in mind, I am relying as much on the work of David Harvey as on Giovanni Arrighi, Robert Brenner and others, who have proposed ways of thinking historical causality after the complications wrought by the forces of globalization and, above all, financialization, which have come to determine communications networks and to reshape what we mean by time, place and cause.

For Harvey, Arrighi, Brenner and others (despite numerous differences), the oil crisis of 1973 was a signal moment for strategies on the part of First World nations to keep profits high, strategies that we now refer to in the unexamined shorthand of ‘globalization’: cheap labour in the underdeveloped world, moving from Fordist to post-Fordist production techniques, emphasizing supply chains over production on the factory floor in the interest of exacting profits more efficiently (to bear the expense of labour less), not to mention new rounds of primitive accumulation exacted by the IMF during the new economy of the Thatcher–Reagan years in the wake of stagnating growth caused by the crisis. We need to describe and trace – through the aetiology provided by cultural production – this hornet’s nest of complex determinations wrought by capitalist forms of valorization predicated on the mass movement of people across the planet. What Harvey would call ‘deterritorialization’ and ‘reterritorialization’ – enforced by the creative destruction and reconsolidation of everyday life under the dictates of advanced capital – change the very notions of context and causality.

zh: 于是，进入“后媒介状况”。
en: Enter ‘the post-medium condition’.

zh: 流离失所问题的反复出现，可能引出安置本身究竟意味着什么的问题。或许可以说，在一个本身诞生于冷战、推崇专业化的制度与职业秩序中，艺术实践成为最后一片规定不足（或相反，过度编码）的空间，使人们得以探索那些渗透日常生活如此多方面、否则不可能被容纳于一个有限研究领域的问题集。从阿多诺到萨义德，离散的结构状况常被理解为——无论多么暴力——现代性所生成的集体转化既定过程之一。然而在现代性的历史性中，或许可以注意到，暴力流离失所的形式在强度和频率上都在加速。离散是一种跨越民族国家与大陆的大规模社会重组，是资本主义创造性毁灭的加速所迫成的；资本主义周期性地重构自身，一方面为了开采资源，另一方面为了更高效地从劳动中榨取剩余价值。
en: The recurrence of the question of displacement may beg the question of the very meaning of placement. It might be said that in an institutional and professional order, itself born of the cold war, in which specialization is prized, art practices become the last underdetermined (or, in contrast, over-coded) space to enable the exploration of problem sets saturating so many aspects of everyday life as to be otherwise impossible to contain in a circumscribed field of study. From Adorno to Said, the structural condition of diaspora is frequently understood to be, however violent, one of the given processes of collective transformation born of modernity. And yet within the historicity of modernity, it might be noted that forms of violent displacement are accelerating in intensity and frequency. Diaspora is a form of mass social reorganization across nation-states and continents necessitated by the acceleration of capitalism’s creative destruction, as it periodically restructures in the interest of resource mining, on the one hand, and, on the other hand, ever more efficient ways of extracting surplus value from labour.

zh: 资本主义不断转移地点、寻找剩余劳动力储备的需求，促使劳动与资本之间的关系不断变化，这已为世界大部分人口重绘了时间与空间的坐标。1945年与1973年都是关键日期，标志着语境、起源与因果性基本含义的根本变化。不断变化的经验与历史条件开始要求包括人文学科在内的学术探究去探索那些支撑古典分析形式的基本坐标；其中，作为稳定地点与时间的“语境”是根本性的。
en: The shifting relationship between labour and capital, required by capitalism’s peripatetic need for pools of surplus labour, has redrawn the coordinates of time and space for much of the world’s population. 1945 and 1973 are both crucial dates that mark fundamental changes in the basic meanings of context, origin and causality. Changing empirical and historical conditions begin to demand scholarly inquiry, including the humanities, to explore the basic coordinates that subtend classical forms of analysis, of which context, understood as a stable place and time, is fundamental.

zh: 此处的悖论、或辩证的纠缠在于：语境（定义为作品生产的时间与地点）继续是艺术社会史最基本的确定项之一，同时却也成为其首要问题之一。在语境感知——必然受网络化传播支配、与金融化密切相关——的解根化与重构之后，什么构成一个稳定的时间与地点，即一个语境？金融化使全球的“银行”（一组操作）在一个人的生活中，比正在经历这一“生活”的人更具因果能动性。自批判决定论的理论（后结构主义）兴起以来，过去数十年中，能动性与主体性的形成一直是迫切的问题，然而语境仍是一个稳定的范畴。
en: The paradox, or dialectical involution, here is that while context (defined as the time and place in which a work is produced) continues to be one of social history of art’s most basic certainties, it also becomes one of its primary questions. What constitutes a stable time and place – that is, a context – in the wake of the deracination and reconstitution of its perception necessarily governed by networked communication, intimately bound up with financialization, which has made ‘the bank’ (a set of operations) across the globe more causally active in a life than s/he who is experiencing this ‘life’? Agency and the formation of subjectivity have been pressing matters of concern over the last several decades in the wake of theories critical of determination (post-structuralism) and yet context has remained a stable category.

zh: 语境本身，即对文化连贯性具有根本意义的时间与空间基本母体，必须被重新定义，因为它已被资本主义重构，从而重构了因果性的线索。
资本重绘了时间与空间的线索，面对历史的运动，恢复连贯性的迫切需要乘着图表而来，因为图表具有独特能力，能回应晚期现代性中的实在抽象与物化。
en: Context itself, the basic matrix of time and space fundamental to cultural coherence, must be redefined, given the fact that it has been already restructured by capitalism, thereby restructuring lines of causality.

The urgent need to find coherence again in response to the movement of history wherein capital has redrawn the lines of time and space rides in on the diagram because of its singular capacity to respond to both real abstraction and reification in late modernity.

zh: 转向图表之运作能力、背离再现逻辑与表现冲动的作品数量——由杜尚与毕卡比亚，也包括俄／苏与意大利未来主义——使1915—1920年成为通过线性重新思考表达之根本参数的生成性时刻。我们可以带有倾向性地把这些实践定位为众多文化实例，标示图表作为启发式装置被纯粹审美地挪用、并加以精炼和发展的过程。但这一文化发展的展开，反过来可以被表明追踪着一种平行的双重运动：资本主义生产方式将自身整合进审美实践的形式，而这些新形式反过来又提供描述资本对世界之激进重组的诸种方式。虽然不可能把一方（图表的谱系）映射到另一方（资本对全球市场再整合的历史性）上，两种探究（美学与社会场域）共有的模式仍然浮现。在没有任何因果关联的情况下，线的转变仍然标记着资本主义贫困化的进程，以及进步诸时刻之间的过渡点。
en: The number of works that turn away from representational logic and expressive drives toward the operational capacity of the diagram – by Duchamp and Picabia but also within Russian/ Soviet and Italian Futurism – mark 1915–20 as a generative time in rethinking the very parameters of articulation through linearity. We could tendentiously situate these practices as so many cultural instances marking the elaboration and development of the purely aesthetic appropriation of the diagram as a heuristic device. But this unfolding of a cultural development, in turn, could be shown to track a parallel, double movement where the capitalist mode of production integrates itself into forms of aesthetic praxis but, reciprocally, these new forms in turn afford ways of describing the radical reordering of the world by capital. While it would be impossible to map the one (the genealogy of the diagram) onto the other (the historicity of capitalist reintegration of global markets), a pattern common to both inquiries (aesthetics and the social field) nonetheless emerges. In the absence of any causal correlation, the transformation of line nevertheless marks the progress of capitalist immiseration and the transitional points between moments of progress.
